proof_scope: Primary-source and export audit only, no live IOMMU configuration or device execution.

facts.fact: Device initialization can invoke bus dma_configure before a driver is bound.
ADD_DEVICE probes IOMMU; error returns NOTIFY_DONE. REMOVED_DEVICE releases its IOMMU state. Successful PCI scan alone does not prove association.
fwspec records IOMMU fwnode and stream IDs; getter is inline at1180.
pci_real_dma_dev is a declaration, not an inline helper.
pci_for_each_dma_alias is declared but absent from fixed vmlinux.symvers.

consequences: Prepare provider availability and host map before PCI publication; retain all owners through IOMMU cleanup.
Require fwspec/provider/SID and translated domain observations after scan before claiming association.
Do not call unavailable PCI alias helpers from the external module or ignore modpost. A separate bounded alias contract or explicit reviewed kernel export is needed before driver/DMA.
No physical IRQ/MSI, DMA, radio or energy proof from this audit.
